name: week
title: Preservation week
subtitle: Private snapshot. Check files again before a transfer.

sections.title: Accessions
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,files,underprotected,readiness from v_accession_queue order by code

sections.title: Attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by code,finding

sections.title: Location labels
sections.note: Labels are operator supplied. Separate labels do not prove independent storage.
sections.sql: select * from v_storage order by location

sections.title: Files needing copies
sections.sql: select code,name,verified_locations,failures from v_file_health where verified_locations<2 order by code,name

sections.title: Format decisions
sections.sql: select extension,risk,action,review_on,evidence from formats order by extension

sections.title: Record checks
sections.sql: select code,rule,finding from v_compliance order by code,rule
